message.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
message.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We can accept your terms and await your order.
Our terms: a price of €361.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
Please note:
We acknowledge your proposal to implement the CU-NOTATION index clause, which effectively mitigates material risk and allows us to reduce the base price accordingly.
However, extending the payment terms to 90 days does not align with our internal financial guidelines and cannot be accepted.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.

Legal Department: We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION, CU-NOTATION.
